map.同一 3 分钟音频：MP3 320 kbps ≈ 320×180/8/1024: For the same 3 minutes of audio: MP3 320 kbps is about 320×180/8/1024 ≈ 7.03 MB; 192 kbps ≈ 4.22 MB; 128 kbps ≈ 2.81 MB (WAV would be about 30.3 MB).
